description: Test suite for the codex-native-web-search module, including helper functions, configuration, and activation logic for web search tools within a larger AI assistant framework.

methods.name: describeCodexNativeWebSearch
methods.description: Provides a description or configuration summary for the native web search feature.

methods.name: resolveCodexNativeWebSearchConfig
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes the web search configuration settings, such as allowed domains and user location.

methods.name: buildCodexNativeWebSearchTool
methods.description: Constructs the web search tool object with specified filters and settings.

methods.name: patchCodexNativeWebSearchPayload
methods.description: Injects the native web search tool into the existing payload if not already present.

methods.name: shouldSuppressManagedWebSearchTool
methods.description: Determines if the managed web search tool should be suppressed based on current configuration and model provider.

methods.name: isCodexNativeWebSearchRelevant
methods.description: Checks whether the current model and configuration make native web search relevant.

methods.name: resolveCodexNativeSearchActivation
methods.description: Decides the activation state of native Codex search based on configuration, model provider, and authentication.

ctags.name: payload
ctags.pattern: /^    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = { tools: [{ type: "function", name: "read" }] };$/

ctags.name: payload
ctags.pattern: /^    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = { tools: [{ type: "web_search" }] };$/

ctags.name: result
ctags.pattern: /^    const result = patchCodexNativeWebSearchPayload({ payload, config: baseConfig });$/
